definition.name: open_gripper
definition.description:
Open the selected gripper.
Use when: you are choosing to release an object or to reset the jaws, and nothing else should move.
Effect: runs one committed sequence through the Supervisor and consumes one robot decision: open (open the gripper), on the arm you name; the other arm is not commanded. It dispatches at most 1 primitive action; the Supervisor admits every one like the matching atomic command. The end-effector pose target is held unchanged.
Returns: a submitted acknowledgement now; on the next turn a staged receipt with one entry per stage that ran (status, reason, measurements), the stages not reached, and a fresh observation.
Does not: establish separation, stable support, correct placement or task success; report jaw separation or what, if anything, was released.
On error: Refused: an argument outside this schema (invalid_arguments, naming the field); another committed sequence is still running (skill_sequence_active); a placement is waiting at its pre-release stop (skill_sequence_paused); the episode has reached its terminal boundary (episode_terminal). A refusal submits nothing: correct the named field, or act on current evidence, before calling again.

arm.description: The arm that runs the whole sequence. The other arm is not commanded and holds its current targets.

rationale.description: One short sentence saying why you chose this action now, at most 200 characters. It is echoed into the receipt and is the only record of the reason: the trajectory keeps the call and its result, never the reasoning behind them.

claim_boundary: submitted is not executed: the staged receipt on the next turn reports what each stage did, and no stage outcome certifies task success
